spec.title: Mensajes totales
spec.description: Total de mensajes ACARS en el rango seleccionado

spec.query:
from(bucket: "airframes")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r._measurement == "airframes_event" and
      r._field == "event_count" and
      r.airframe_icao =~ /^${ICAO:regex}$/
  )
  |> group()
  |> sum()

from(bucket: "airframes")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r._measurement == "airframes_event" and
      r._field == "event_count" and
      r.airframe_icao =~ /^${ICAO:regex}$/
  )
  |> group(columns: ["source_type"])
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)

spec.title: Aeronaves únicas
spec.description: Número de ICAO distintos vistos en el rango

spec.query:
from(bucket: "airframes")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r._measurement == "airframes_event" and
      r._field == "event_count" and
      r.airframe_icao =~ /^${ICAO:regex}$/
  )
  |> keep(columns: ["airframe_icao"])
  |> group()
  |> distinct(column: "airframe_icao")
  |> count()

spec.title: Decodificados (libacars)
spec.description: Porcentaje de mensajes decodificados correctamente por libacars

spec.query:
from(bucket: "airframes")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r._measurement == "airframes_event" and
      r._field == "libacars_ok" and
      r.airframe_icao =~ /^${ICAO:regex}$/
  )
  |> group()
  |> mean()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 100.0}))

spec.title: Actividad de mensajes
spec.description: Volumen de mensajes agregado en ventanas de 30 minutos

spec.query:
from(bucket: "airframes")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r._measurement == "airframes_event" and
      r._field == "event_count" and
      r.airframe_icao =~ /^${ICAO:regex}$/
  )
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 30m, fn: sum, createEmpty: true)
  |> fill(value: 0)

spec.title: Mensajes
spec.description: Últimos 500 mensajes del rango. Filtra por ICAO con la variable superior.

spec.query:
import "strings"

from(bucket: "airframes")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r._measurement == "airframes_event" and
      r.airframe_icao =~ /^${ICAO:regex}$/
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r._field == "text" or
      r._field == "libacars_text" or
      r._field == "libacars_ok" or
      r._field == "tail" or
      r._field == "flight" or
      r._field == "flight_uid"
  )
  |> pivot(
      rowKey: [
        "_time",
        "airframe_icao",
        "station",
        "country",
        "source",
        "source_type",
        "label"
      ],
      columnKey: ["_field"],
      valueColumn: "_value"
  )
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 500)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
      libacars_text: if exists r.libacars_text then strings.replaceAll(v: r.libacars_text, t: "\\n", u: "\n") else "",
      flight_uid: if exists r.flight_uid then r.flight_uid else ""
  }))
  |> keep(columns: [
      "_time",
      "airframe_icao",
      "tail",
      "flight",
      "station",
      "country",
      "label",
      "source_type",
      "libacars_ok",
      "text",
      "libacars_text",
      "flight_uid"
  ])

from(bucket: "airframes")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r._measurement == "airframes_event" and
      r._field == "event_count" and
      r.airframe_icao =~ /^${ICAO:regex}$/
  )
  |> group(columns: ["station"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 30m, fn: sum)

spec.title: Vuelos activos (MDINI)
spec.description: Vuelos abiertos por un mensaje H1 #MDINI/INI que aún no han sido cerrados por el siguiente.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "airframes")
  |> range(start: 0)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r._measurement == "airframes_flight" and
      r._field == "status" and
      r.airframe_icao =~ /^${ICAO:regex}$/
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value == "active")
  |> group()
  |> count()

spec.title: Vuelos (MDINI)
spec.description: Vuelos abiertos por mensajes H1 #MDINI/INI: callsign, origen/destino, dataref y estado. Un flight_uid agrupa todos los mensajes recibidos mientras el vuelo estuvo activo.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "airframes")
  |> range(start: 0)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r._measurement == "airframes_flight" and
      r.airframe_icao =~ /^${ICAO:regex}$/
  )
  |> pivot(
      rowKey: ["airframe_icao", "flight_uid"],
      columnKey: ["_field"],
      valueColumn: "_value"
  )
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["opened_at"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 500)
  |> keep(columns: [
      "airframe_icao",
      "callsign",
      "departure",
      "arrival",
      "dataref",
      "status",
      "message_count",
      "opened_at",
      "last_seen",
      "closed_at",
      "flight_uid"
  ])

import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"

schema.tagValues(
  bucket: "airframes",
  tag: "airframe_icao",
  start: v.timeRangeStart
)
